title: Claude vs ChatGPT: Which AI wins? #ai #claude #chatgpt
description:
What can Claude do that ChatGPT can't? Here are 5 features that are worth knowing about when comparing the two leading AI tools:
- Usage limits and ads
- The vibe and tone of voice of each LLM
- Skills: a central part of how you train Claude
- Live artefacts - live dashboards of your information
- Claude Design: a dedicated part of the Claude app for building detailed design systems and producing consistent on-brand design work

#claude #chatgpt #anthropic #ai #aitools #artificialintelligence #llm #openai #tech #technology #learnontiktok
